response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the 6+ years fullstack requirement with ~15 years across web, backend, mobile and embedded, and his recent roles map closely to the stack: TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS CDK, GraphQL, Docker/Kubernetes, plus current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators — a rare and explicitly required skill. He has a CS bachelor's, deep testing culture (authored a test runner and assertion library, taught TDD/Selenium courses), and demonstrated communication ability through workshops and conference talks. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Kotlin evidence) and his frontend depth is more Ember than React, but these are easily bridgeable for an engineer of this breadth. Worth interviewing, with technical probing on React depth and modern Node testing tooling.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack with strong TypeScript/Node.js and cloud/container experience
Direct AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, matching a hard-to-source requirement
Exceptional testing/TDD credentials — built test frameworks, teaches workshops
concerns: No evidence of Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest specifically
React exposure limited to one role; frontend history is largely Ember.js
Kotlin absent and Java experience dates back to 2018; relational DB depth unclear

key_factors.factor: Missing specific stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
